resources.string: Review setup without changing your current preferences
Make your home screen your own
A few steps to explore KeiHome and check what is ready. You can skip optional setup and return here from Settings.
Built-in and installed packs, light and dark icons, and Monet colors.
Explore Dock glass, launcher glass styles and long app names.
The guide does not enable features or apply themes automatically.
KeiHome uses LSPosed API 102. Enable the module in your manager and grant the scopes needed by the features you use. You can continue even if setup is incomplete.
A granted scope and a connected service do not guarantee that hooks are running. Check the Status page for the actual launcher connection.
Open an existing catalog to preview and apply a pack, then return here. Your current icon pack stays selected unless you change it.
Use an icon pack already installed on your device.
Import and manage native theme or icon pack files.
Applying uses the system Themes app. Coverage, fallback icons and Monet options are available in Icon packs.
Explore the same controls as the Desktop tab. Supported changes sync automatically; availability depends on the launcher. Opening this page keeps your settings unchanged.
Dock glass, corner styles, glass rendering and app names.
You have reached the end of the guide. Optional setup can be completed later, and this guide is always available in Settings.
The Status page shows module and launcher health. Finishing this guide does not imply that every scope or feature is active.
Launcher or hook issues: LSPosed logs. Interface or settings issues: app logs.
